title: Daily Signal Brief 022 — EU AI Act Annex III HR deferred 16 months; Colorado AI Act shelved; NYC AEDT sharpens
summary: EU AI Act Annex III HR-and-employment obligations postponed from 2 Aug 2026 to 2 Dec 2027 under the Digital Omnibus (Parliament approved 16 June; Council formal approval pending; adoption expected before 2 Aug 2026) — Forge + Helm's pending file / do-not-file call gets re-framed from compliance-readiness-statement to 'we built to the original calendar; here is what we shipped,' ships Friday EOD. Colorado AI Act effectively shelved (enforcement moves from 30 June 2026 to 1 Jan 2027; Littler frames as 'substantially reducing obligations'; multiple firms flag 'strong likelihood it will never be implemented'). NYC AEDT counter-current — Comptroller audit of DCWP found Local Law 144 enforcement 'currently ineffective'; DCWP committed to most recommendations, signaling enforcement-rigor turn. Operative inference: the regulatory-deadline-driven case for compliance moats just lost its calendar urgency in EU + Colorado; the litigation-driven case (Mobley/Lin California, from yesterday's brief) is now the binding constraint. The compliance-as-moat strategy is unchanged in substance, but Compass's Friday narrative-shift must now lead with statute-to-litigation framing rather than EU-August-deadline urgency.
